meta.name: ecommerce-full-pipeline
meta.description: 跨境电商全链路自动化工具。集成1688采集、智能清洗、多平台上架（微信小店/Shopify/TikTok）、推广方案（关键词/竞品分析/广告文案）、短视频创作（MoviePy竖屏视频）、一键代发、爆品挖掘（趋势聚合+6维评分）、闲鱼二手选品捡漏（品牌识别/虚标过滤/捡漏评分/价格监控）、全自动流水线（挖掘→采集→清洗→上架→推广→视频）。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化处理跨境电商选品、上架到推广全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是跨境电商卖家，希望一键完成从选品到推广的全链路
copy.tagline_en: Automate the entire cross-border ecommerce pipeline from sourcing to promotion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a cross-border ecommerce seller wanting to automate the full workflow from sourcing to promotion

howto.what: 装上后，当你说出商品关键词或选品需求，Claude 会调用对应的命令行工具来执行操作：采集 1688 商品、清洗数据、生成上架文件、推广文案、竖屏视频，或挖掘爆品、闲鱼捡漏等。
howto.when: 当用户提出开展跨境电商业务，涉及选品、上架、推广等需求，或要求闲鱼捡漏时触发。

say.text: 帮我从1688采集‘蓝牙耳机’的商品，导出清洗后的数据
say.note: 会执行采集和清洗命令

say.text: 挖掘一下电子类目的趋势爆品，取前10个
say.note: 运行趋势挖掘，输出候选爆品列表

say.text: 在闲鱼上找1000元以下、支持4K的投影仪
say.note: 触发闲鱼捡漏搜索，返回评分结果

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you provide product keywords or sourcing needs, Claude runs the relevant command-line tool: it can scrape 1688 products, clean data, generate listing templates, ad copy, vertical videos, or perform trend mining and Xianyu bargain hunting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to run an e-commerce business, involving product selection, listing, promotion, video creation, or Xianyu second-hand bargain hunting.

say_en.text: Scrape 'Bluetooth earphones' from 1688 and export cleaned data.
Discover top 10 trend products in electronics.
say_en.note: Runs trend mining and outputs candidates.

say_en.text: Find a projector under 1000 yuan with 4K support on Xianyu.
say_en.note: Triggers bargain hunt and returns scores.
